svg.font-family: 'Noto Sans KR','Malgun Gothic','Apple SD Gothic Neo','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif
svg.title: Completion conditions for Levels 1, 2 and 3
svg.desc: Shows the completion conditions of the three completion levels this book defines for teaching (Design complete, Environment set up, Work executed and verified). Each level includes every condition of the level below it.
svg.text: Author's interpretation · for teaching, not a certification · a learner's self-assessment (2-9)
· Real work done with AI using allowed material (organization-allowed service and account;
CH03 tier A or masked B) ([Live AI run: approved work data])
· CH12 verification checklist, error log, and human final confirmation record exist
Level 1 + actually set up in the tools available to you
· Local folders actually created · where available, the cloud folder and the AI Project
· Pre-run security check passed · one backup and restore done with fictional files
· Finished preparing to run with fictional material
① final workspace map ② work purpose and scope ③ folder and material management rules
④ AI Project settings (a design sheet is OK) ⑤ work instructions ⑥ work workflow
⑦ verification checklist ⑧ backup and operating rules
· They agree in the connection check table (mismatches recorded)
· You can explain the candidate A task from the documents alone · a simulated run may be included
Reachable even if account or organization limits prevent a live run
